description: Apply this skill whenever you need to design test cases using State Transition Testing. Use when given requirements describing a system whose behavior depends on its current state AND its history of events — not just the current input alone. Triggers include: "design test cases", "test state machine", "test workflow", "test lifecycle", "state transition", "FSM", or any requirement describing: user authentication flows, account lifecycles, order/transaction workflows, session management, multi-step wizards, embedded system controllers, or any feature where the same event produces different outcomes depending on what happened previously.
